# opnsense_kea_dhcpv6_pd_pool (Data Source)

Reads a typed DHCPv6 delegated-prefix pool by UUID on OPNsense 26.7.7 or newer. The appliance returns the prefix as an address-only value; CIDR spelling preservation applies only to the managed resource configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opnsense_kea_dhcpv6_pd_pool" "clients" {
  id = "12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID to look up.

### Read-Only

- `delegated_len` (Number) Length delegated to each client; must be longer than prefix_len.
- `description` (String) Description of the delegated-prefix pool.
- `prefix` (String) Aligned IPv6 aggregate prefix address exactly as returned by the API (address-only, without CIDR suffix).
- `prefix_len` (Number) Length of the aggregate prefix.
- `subnet_id` (String) UUID of the parent Kea DHCPv6 subnet.
